from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,zipfile,io
root=Path.cwd();stage=root/'.local/step07/fix-round3/final';source='ef30dc2ab011d204d1d0a4d099a335b68458cdca'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==source
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
p=next(root.glob('artifacts/step07-ef30dc2a*/manifest.json'));j=json.loads(p.read_text());assert j['commit']==source
rows=[]
for name,h in j['files'].items():
 actual=sha((root/name).read_bytes());assert actual==h,(name,actual,h);rows.append({'path':name,'sha256':actual,'bytes':(root/name).stat().st_size})
assert len(rows)==206
(stage/'engineering-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'buildId':j['buildId'],'manifestSHA256':sha(p.read_bytes()),'manifest':str(p.relative_to(root)),'payloads':len(rows),'allActualDiskHashesMatch':True,'immutablePublishedManifestModified':False,'files':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
protected=json.loads((root/'.local/step07/fix-round3/protected-baseline.json').read_text());changed=[n for n,h in protected.items() if sha((root/n).read_bytes())!=h];assert not changed
scope=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','36dc5cca1a7da77314e6889648d464d32ba0751f',source],text=True).splitlines();assert len(scope)==4
files={name:sha((root/name).read_bytes()) for name in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines() if not name.startswith('docs/') and name!='README.md'}
(stage/'source-files.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'files':files},indent=2)+'\n')
(stage/'preservation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'protectedFiles':len(protected),'changed':changed,'sourceChangedPaths':scope,'nonDocumentationFiles':len(files),'mainReviewerCanonicalWritten':False,'plansProfileGoldenPrototypeChanged':False,'serverNativeQueueBudgetsChanged':False},indent=2)+'\n')
ziprows=[]
for mode in ['browser-production','browser-dev']:
 evidence=json.loads((stage/mode/'evidence.json').read_text());assert evidence['sourceCommit']==source and not evidence['errors'];assert all(p['actualSha']==p['independentReferenceSha'] for p in evidence['pixelChecks'])
 for file in sorted((stage/mode).glob('*export.zip')):
  data=file.read_bytes()
  with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
   assert z.testzip() is None and len(z.namelist())==8 and len(set(z.namelist()))==8
   mbytes=z.read('manifest.json');manifest=json.loads(mbytes);definition=manifest['identity'];profile=definition['profile'];identity=manifest['buildId']
   assert definition['context']['commit']==source,(file,definition.keys())
   assert definition['profileHash']=='48844001eea07a8cf0da4baf9abb1653b01c38a9405413ed3123df189cf48793'
   assert sha(json.dumps(profile,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode())==definition['profileHash']
   payload=[]
   for name,f in definition['files'].items():
    byte=z.read(name);assert sha(byte)==f['sha256'] and len(byte)==f['bytes'];payload.append({'file':name,**f})
   if file.name=='first-export.zip':assert sha(data)==evidence['zipSha'] and sha(mbytes)==evidence['manifestSha'] and identity==evidence['exportBuildId']
   ziprows.append({'mode':mode,'file':file.name,'sha256':sha(data),'bytes':len(data),'buildId':identity,'manifestSHA256':sha(mbytes),'profile':profile,'payloads':payload})
(stage/'zip-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'actualZipCRCAndEightSafeFilesVerified':True,'actualBrowserPNGManifestProfileAndReferenceAssertions':'formal e2e logs/evidence','exports':ziprows},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'buildId':j['buildId'],'manifestSHA256':sha(p.read_bytes()),'files':len(rows),'protected':len(protected),'sourceFiles':len(files),'zipCount':len(ziprows)}))
